g.text: Unfolded longitudinal sections / 1:1 horizontal and vertical scale / eye height = floor +1.674 m
All flights: 12 m horizontal run, open sky above both landings and every tread. Side guards 1.10 m above nosing line with .20 m thickness outside the 4 m clear width.
Retaining infill supports the flight. These are exact design envelopes, not compiled stair or camera measurements.
